definition.aa: Artificial Analysis Free rows matched by base model name; AA Free v5 returns null coding/agentic, so use openRouter for that signal
definition.coding: primary coding rating: OpenRouter -> official -> selfReported; value is 0-1
definition.note: normalizedScore is scaled to 0-1; means are simple averages across benchmarks, not a composite rating
definition.official: self_reported === false - a third-party/leaderboard number, not the vendor's own claim
definition.openRouter: OpenRouter's mirrored AA indices (coding/intelligence/agentic), input modalities, and design_arena Elo
definition.selfReported: self_reported === true - the vendor's own published number
definition.verified: verified === true - independently reproduced by ZeroEval (currently 0)
definition.writing: EQ-Bench Creative Writing v3 (independent LLM-judged evaluation); elo is the pairwise-comparison rating, score is the 0-20 rubric-adjacent index; null when the model was not evaluated or the name join failed
